item.title: Baldur's Gate 3 vs Elden Ring. Which game would win GOTY if they released in the same year?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Trollvind)
item.dc:creator: Trollvind
item.content:encoded: The two highest rated games this generation both sitting at a 96 on metacritic. Both destroyed titans in TOTK and God of War Ragnarok, two franchises that have won the award in the past. General consensus is that these two are the top 2 this gen.
